# Local frontend dependencies

The browser loads these files from the application itself; no CDN request is needed at runtime.

- jQuery 3.7.1: https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.7.1.min.js
- Select2 4.0.13: https://github.com/select2/select2/tree/4.0.13/dist
- Installation reference: https://select2.org/getting-started/installation/

MIT licenses are included as JQUERY-LICENSE.txt and SELECT2-LICENSE.md.
